description: This file is a shell script designed to test the handling of UTF-8 normalization forms (NFD and NFC) within Git, including operations like diff, commit, checkout, and rename with filenames containing Unicode characters. It sets up a Git repository, configures Unicode normalization options, creates files with decomposed and precomposed UTF-8 characters, and runs various tests to verify proper Unicode normalization handling.

methods.name: ls_files_nfc_nfd
methods.description: Function to set up Git test environment with Unicode precompose/unicode options and compare the listed files to expected results for files with NFC/NFD normalized filenames.
